patch_list: Allow Screenshots & Screen Security Bypass - SimpleX (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Neutralizes FLAG_SECURE window flags in SimpleX Chat, allowing screenshots and screen sharing without black screens.
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Replaces dark grey backgrounds with pure OLED pitch black (#000000) across SimpleX Chat conversation screens and network status monitors.
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Unlocks instant multi-profile quick switching, quantum-resistant encryption toggles, and donor profile styling in SimpleX Chat.
